CoachChatRequest.description: POST /coach/chat: a question plus the earlier turns the app keeps (not stored here).
CoachChatRequest.title: CoachChatRequest

GameService.description:
Doubles (v1.3): who serves and receives first in a game after the first (D23).

The winners of a game choose, so the user names them; the game winner's side serves.
GameService.title: GameService

GameServiceIn.description:
Doubles: who serves and receives first in a game after the first (both, or neither
to forget the game's slots). The game winner's side serves.
GameServiceIn.title: GameServiceIn

LineCall.description: Automated in/out call for one landing; never an official call.
LineCall.title: LineCall

LineCallOverrideBody.description: PATCH /jobs/{id}/line-calls/{n}: confirm (same call) or override (other call).
LineCallOverrideBody.title: LineCallOverrideBody

LineCallUpdate.description: PATCH /jobs/{id}/line-calls/{n} response: calls, rallies and score after re-scoring.
LineCallUpdate.title: LineCallUpdate

Moment.description: A point on the timeline the app can seek to.
Moment.title: Moment

PersonalityConfig.description: Optional on every chat request; without it the coach is exactly as before.
PersonalityConfig.title: PersonalityConfig

Score.description:
The current game's score (the last game's once the match is over) and match state.

`near` and `far` are the ends of the court as they are now (v1.7): when the players
change ends, the points, games and server move with them and `ends_swapped` flips.
Score.title: Score

ScoreAwardIn.description: A point for a rally the referee layer missed.
ScoreAwardIn.title: ScoreAwardIn

ScoreConcedeIn.description: The other side retired or gave a walkover: `winner` wins the match at `frame`.
ScoreConcedeIn.title: ScoreConcedeIn

ScoreCorrection.description:
A user's score change: a rally's winner set or cleared, a point awarded, or a match
conceded.

An award is a point for a rally the referee layer missed; it counts after the detected
rallies before rally_index (the number of rallies when it was given). A concession
(v1.5) ends the match there: `winner_after` wins because the other side retired.
`ends` (v1.7) says the players changed ends there, early, late or against the automatic
change: it sits where an award would and has no winner.
ScoreCorrection.title: ScoreCorrection

ScoreEndsIn.description: The players changed ends at `frame`: early, late, or against the automatic change.
ScoreEndsIn.title: ScoreEndsIn

ScoreUpdate.description:
PATCH /jobs/{id}/score response: the new score and every rally's score_after.

`line_calls` is set by an undo, which can take back a line-call override (D32).
ScoreUpdate.title: ScoreUpdate

post.description:

POST /jobs/{id}/chat. Answers are not saved: the app keeps the conversation.
